newsitem.title: FRANCE: AXA shareholders approve capital boost.
newsitem.headline: AXA shareholders approve capital boost.

text.p: Shareholders of French insurer Axa agreed on Wednesday plans to issue 111.1 million new shares as part of an exchange offer with insurance group UAP.
The two companies announced in mid-November a share exchange in a merger that will create the world's second largest insurer.
Board member Gerard de la Martiniere told shareholders that the new share was likely to be issued at 270 francs, representing a premium of 210 francs.
Shareholders also agreed the issue of 128 million certificates of guaranteed value to UAP shareholders.
